## Figure 1.11: Average Interest Rates on New External Debt Commitments for IBRD and IDA-Eligible Countries, by Bondholders, 2015–25
Line chart.

- **Units:** Percent
- **X-axis:** Years, 2015–2025
- **Y-axis:** Percent, range **0 to 14**
- **Series / legend:**
  - **IDA-eligible countries** (dark blue line)
  - **IBRD countries** (light blue line)

### Approximate values by year
Values are estimated from line positions because no printed point labels are shown.

| Year | IDA-eligible countries | IBRD countries |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2015 | ≈7.8 | ≈5.2 |
| 2016 | ≈7.3 | ≈6.5 |
| 2017 | ≈6.2 | ≈4.8 |
| 2018 | ≈7.2 | ≈6.1 |
| 2019 | ≈7.2 | ≈5.5 |
| 2020 | ≈5.9 | ≈4.5 |
| 2021 | ≈6.7 | ≈4.6 |
| 2022 | ≈7.9 | ≈4.6 |
| 2023 | ≈11.9 | ≈6.1 |
| 2024 | ≈8.4 | ≈5.8 |
| 2025 | ≈9.3 | ≈5.5 |

### Visual comparisons and trends
- **IDA-eligible countries** have a higher average interest rate than **IBRD countries in every year shown**.
- For **IDA-eligible countries**, the **highest** point is in **2023** at **≈11.9 percent**; the **lowest** point is in **2020** at **≈5.9 percent**.
- For **IBRD countries**, the **highest** point is in **2016** at **≈6.5 percent**; the **lowest** points are around **2020–2022**, at **≈4.5–4.6 percent**.
- The gap between the two series is **largest in 2023**, when IDA-eligible countries spike sharply while IBRD countries rise only modestly.
- From **2015 to 2022**, both series fluctuate within relatively moderate ranges, with IDA-eligible countries mostly between **≈6 and 8 percent** and IBRD countries mostly between **≈4.5 and 6.5 percent**.
- In **2023**, the IDA-eligible line jumps steeply from **≈7.9** to **≈11.9 percent**, then falls back in **2024** before edging up again in **2025**.
- The IBRD series is comparatively stable across the whole period, with a mild rise in **2023** followed by slight easing in **2024–25**.
- There are **no negative values**.

**Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.  
**Note:** IBRD = International Bank for Reconstruction and Development; IDA = International Development Association.
